theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) for Warm Mode
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Clean, minimalist, authoritative, professional, focused, and accessible.

headings.style: tracking-tight, leading-none, bold or black weight depending on context. Banned: Inter, Roboto.
headings.max_size: text-5xl for hero, text-4xl for section headers. Never go beyond text-5xl.

code_and_technical.style: tracking-tight, text-sm. Use for all code blocks, labels, metadata, and admin grids.

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 inside cards and sections. Provide massive breathing room. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Use 'Bento' or 'Control Room' grid strategies. Mobile-first grid-cols-1, scaling to grid-cols-12 for complex landing layouts.
layout_and_spacing.border_strategy: 1px crisp lines. 'Grid Borders' surface strategy where components reveal the structure of the layout. Minimal use of box-shadows. Use subtle inner glow if needed.

component_guidelines.landing_page: Hero section features bold Cabinet Grotesk typography over an abstract structural background. Heavy emphasis on a massive, elegant search bar. Use a 'Bento' grid layout for interview domains.
component_guidelines.domain_page: Filter tabs should use un-rounded or slightly rounded (rounded-sm) buttons. High contrast active states. Clear visual hierarchy.
component_guidelines.qa_interface: Use Shadcn Accordion but strip all default rounding (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Use 1px solid borders separating questions. Content inside should heavily feature JetBrains Mono for syntax highlighting.
component_guidelines.ai_chatbot: Shadcn Sheet component as a slide-out drawer. Must render Markdown correctly. Typography must remain tight and highly readable. Ensure streaming updates are visually anchored.
component_guidelines.admin_panel: Dense 'Control Room' grid. Pure functionality. Use Shadcn Table with compact padding (p-2 to p-4). Monochrome data visualization with JetBrains Mono.

hero_dark_grid.description: Architectural grid lines. Use as a background for Dark Mode hero or admin sections (low opacity).

hero_warm_texture.description: Frosted glass and raw stone texture. Use for Warm Mode hero background or visual accents.

structural_architecture.description: Abstract architecture lines. Ideal for Light Mode hero or category thumbnails.

icons.style: Use regular or light weight for a clean, minimal look. Avoid heavy/filled icons unless active.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement tri-mode theming. In globals.css, set up :root (light), .dark, and .warm CSS variables mapping to Tailwind colors. Use next-themes or a context provider to toggle the HTML class.
Install `@phosphor-icons/react` for iconography. Do not use generic emoji or font-awesome.
Install `react-syntax-highlighter` and `react-markdown` for the Q&A and Chatbot code rendering.
Use standard JS/JSX. No TypeScript (.tsx). Use Javascript for Shadcn components.
Do NOT use raw HTML inputs for complex forms; rely on customized Shadcn primitives. Strip away any 'Vercel-look' default styling (heavy shadows/roundings).
Every interactive or informational element MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='theme-toggle-warm'`).
Avoid generic Tailwind roundings (e.g., rounded-2xl). Keep components sharp (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) to match the Swiss minimalist aesthetic.
Ensure hover states explicitly define text colors (e.g., hover:bg-black hover:text-white). Focus states must be highly visible.
The header must have a solid or glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-xl). Never fully transparent over content.
